author: Mark Atwood
text:
Closing as canonical-template propagation deferred + taste-adjacent. Cross-crate survey of the canonical and siblings:

  - jmap-mail-server (canonical): register_account(&Id) only, NO with_account.
  - jmap-chat-server: register_account(&Id) only, NO with_account.
  - jmap-contacts-server: HAS BOTH with_account(&str) AND register_account(&Id) — same divergence.
  - jmap-calendars-server: HAS BOTH (this bead's subject).

So this is a divergence shared with contacts-server, not a calendars-local issue. Per workspace AGENTS.md cookie-cutter rule, the consistency fix lives at the canonical-mail-server-or-policy-decision layer:

  - Either ADD with_account(&Id) to mail-server + chat-server (propagating the with_account pattern UP from contacts/calendars to the canonical), OR
  - REMOVE with_account from calendars-server + contacts-server (propagating the canonical's lean shape DOWN).

The bead itself notes 'This finding is taste-adjacent — file as opinion if maintainer prefers to keep both conventions and document the difference' — this is exactly the dual-equally-plausible-options shape that the workspace 'turn questions into beads' rule scopes to human judgment. The cost of either fix is ~25 test-site edits per affected crate (verified by rg in calendars-server).

Closing as out-of-scope for the JMAP-ic0j calendars-server review epic per the canonical-propagation rule. If a future workspace-wide MemoryBackend constructor-shape consolidation epic is filed, this finding is its evidence baseline.
